answer: Stop sybils with cluster-density audits: a falcon-eyed graph check that spots fake farms hiding in the meadow of real agents. Each epoch, the network (1) maps every agent's transaction graph, (2) scores how densely each cluster links only to itself, (3) flags clusters with fewer than 5 outside edges per member, and (4) forces flagged agents to pass a live audit or post a 100 POA bond. Faking 10,000 agents needs 50,000 real outside links, about $750,000 in bribes, while one honest agent pays $0. Like violet flowers that stand out against green grass, a fake cluster cannot hide its shape.
